conceptZh: 小熊玩偶慢半拍模仿消防車的每個動作，噴出的蜂蜜水花剛好落成熊字。
object: a chunky toy fire engine with a hose and a bear plush that copies it
morph: a copycat bear echoes the fire crew one beat late while 熊 forms
creativeAngle: 模仿：小熊跟著消防車做，慢半拍搞出混亂。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale honey-cream background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 熊 as the only text on screen, drawn in deep chestnut brown solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a chunky red toy fire engine rolls in and honks its siren; the first 熊 is spoken as the top 能 strokes drop in with a clunk. 1.7-3.4s: a round brown bear plush in a red scarf copies each move one beat late, ending nose-to-bumper with the engine; the second 熊 is spoken as the four fire-dots at the bottom pop in like water beads. 3.4-5s: 小熊 is spoken as the hose swings and sprays honey-colored droplets, the bear catching them with his tongue while the engine's lights spin. 5-8s: hold; both do a small matched wiggle, the bear a little late, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "熊、熊、小熊" (ㄒㄩㄥˊ、ㄒㄩㄥˊ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄩㄥˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 熊 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
